name: Vice City
description: The main city of GTA 6, inspired by Miami. Rockstar calls it the sun and fun capital of America, from the art deco hotels of Ocean Beach to Little Cuba and the VC Port.

name: Vice Beach
description: A beach area in Vice-Dale County, next to Vice City.

name: Gloriana Key
description: A small island in Vice-Dale County. It appears to be based on Virginia Key in Miami.

name: Hamlet
description: A town in Vice-Dale County. It is based on Homestead, Florida.

name: Capri
description: A town in Mariana County. It appears to be based on the Florida cities of Naples and Sebring.

name: Key Lento
description: A town in the Leonida Keys, in all likelihood based on Key Largo. Jason's stilt house stands here.

name: Watson Bay
description: A town in Mariana County, likely based on Cedar Key. The Paradise Garage of the Ultimate Edition is here.

name: Port Gellhorn
description: Leonida's forgotten coast: a once popular vacation spot of cheap motels, closed attractions and empty strip malls. It appears to be based on Panama City, Florida.

name: Ambrosia
description: A sugar town in the heart of Leonida. The Allied Crystal refinery provides the jobs, and the local biker gang nearly everything else.

name: Waning Sands
description: A town in Leonard County, in the north east of Leonida. It appears to be based on the Florida cities of Pembroke Pines and Fort Lauderdale.

name: Stock 305
description: A streetwear store in Stockyard with exclusive looks for Jason and Lucia. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

name: Sara's Unisex Salon
description: A salon with signature styles for Jason and Lucia, including facial hair, makeup and nails. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

name: Electric Fang Tattoo
description: A tattoo parlor in Stockyard with over 50 signature tattoos by the artist collective FAILE. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

name: Jason's House
description: Jason's stilt house in Key Lento, lent to him by Brian. Jason and Lucia's first safehouse, in Chapter 1.

name: Bayside Apartments, 201
description: Boobie's apartment in Bayside, near the Jack of Hearts. He lets Jason and Lucia stay in it in Chapter 3.

name: Starlet Motel
description: Jason and Lucia's motel room in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County: their safehouse in Chapter 2.

name: Hank's Waffles
description: A waffle diner that Jason and Lucia rob in Rockstar's Extended Look gameplay reveal, where the robbery is shown as a flashback.

name: Brian's Boat Works & Marina
description: The boat yard of Brian Heder and his wife Lori in the Leonida Keys. Rockstar describes Brian as a classic drug runner who still moves product through it.

name: Fleeca Field
description: A sports stadium in Rockridge, Vice City, based on LoanDepot Park in Miami.

name: Gellhorn International Raceway
description: A race track near Port Gellhorn. It appears to draw on the real Sebring International Raceway.

name: Lake Leonida
description: The large lake in the middle of Leonida, next to Ambrosia. It is the game's version of Lake Okeechobee.

name: Leonida Penitentiary
description: The prison where Lucia served time before the story begins.

name: Ocean View Hotel
description: The iconic hotel from GTA Vice City returns, on Shore Drive, Ocean Beach.

name: Mount Kalaga National Park
description: A national park on Leonida's northern border, with hunting, fishing and off-road trails. Its canyon appears to be inspired by Providence Canyon in Georgia.

name: Port Vice City
description: The port of Vice City, which Rockstar calls the cruise ship capital of the world. It is based on PortMiami.

name: Sahara Arena
description: An indoor arena on the Downtown Vice City waterfront, home of the Vice City Narcos. It is the game's version of Miami's Kaseya Center.

name: Vice City International Airport
description: The airport of Vice City, modeled after Miami International Airport.

name: Megamundo Building
description: A skyscraper in Downtown Vice City, home of the Megamundo TV network, modeled after Miami's One Biscayne Tower. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia enter it as private security.

name: NINE1NINE
description: A nightclub in Downtown Vice City.

name: The Rusty Anchor
description: A bar in Key Lento, Leonida Keys, seen in Rockstar's Leonida Keys screenshots.

name: Delights
description: A cabaret in Port Gellhorn, seen in Rockstar's Port Gellhorn screenshots.

name: Evergreen Shopping Mall

name: Pegassi Residences South Tower
description: The south one of the two curved Pegassi Residences towers on Tequesta Retreat (Brickell Key), Vice City, which appear in Rockstar's Vice City screenshots.

name: Jack of Hearts
description: Boobie Ike's club in Crosstown, Vice City. Rockstar's line about him: it's all about heart, the Jack of Hearts.

name: Vice City Ferris Wheel

name: Stockyard Walls

name: Naval Air Station
description: The naval air station on Goose Key (Boca Chica Key), at the south western end of the Leonida Keys, with two crossing runways.

name: Grassrivers
description: The wild heart of Leonida: a vast swamp of mangroves and gators, with stranger and deadlier things hidden below the surface.

name: Leonida Keys
description: A chain of laid back tropical islands: casual dress, loaded bars and deck chairs, on the edge of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in America.

name: Vice City Oceanarium

name: Thrillbilly Mud Club

name: Vice City Portal: T.H. Power Station
description: A cheat-code easter egg: climb the Key Lento radio tower, flip the power switch and press the wall button, then flip the lever at each of 12 substations in order without fast travel. After the text, enter T.H. Power Station between 7 pm and 6 am and use the left lever at Reactor 2 to be pulled into an old Vice City Malibu Club scene. Finishing it gives Tommy Vercetti's shirt and his bike.

name: Duster Biplane at LTF Airfield
description: A red Duster biplane is parked at the south end of the LTF Airfield runway, south of Hamlet. It has long range, so flying it over the map uncovers the fog quickly. It is available soon after the first missions.

name: Southside Ubermacht Dealership
description: A walk-in car dealership in Southside with a lot outside and a showroom inside, open daily 8am to 6pm. You can enter through the front doors and look at the cars up close.

name: Trailer Hypercar at Boone Speedway
description: A Truffade hypercar (Thrax or a Chiron-style car, sometimes in a different colour) sits on a trailer at a lot just south of Boone Speedway. Get in, unhook it from the trailer and back it off. It has a tracker, so police will find you, and returning later can spawn another one.

name: Antenna Trailer Hatch Bunker
description: A hatch in a trailer covered in antennas, in a lot across from Griffin Shooting Range, leads down to a bunker. It holds a free H-AT rocket launcher with rockets, frag grenades and the Conspiracist Type 9 SMG. Jump the fence and enter from the north.

name: Kodak Black Poster: Twa Ponya Tattoo
description: A Kodak Black poster sits on a table just right of the entrance inside Twa Ponya Tattoo. Scan it with the Waink app to count toward the Kodak Black radio unlock.

name: Kodak Black Poster: Drip Drops
description: A Kodak Black poster is on the counter beside the clerk inside the Drip Drops clothing store. Scan it with the Waink app to count toward the Kodak Black radio unlock.

name: Kodak Black Poster: Aunt Zola's Soul Food
description: A Kodak Black poster hangs inside Aunt Zola's Soul Food, left of the register. Scan it with the Waink app; it is one of five posters that unlock the Kodak Black radio playlist.

name: Kodak Black Poster: Jack of Hearts Studio
description: A Kodak Black poster is next to a fan in the studio, up the stairs on the right inside Jack of Hearts. Only available from Chapter 3, and scanning it completes the Kodak Black radio unlock.

name: Marbelle Hotel Haunted Interior
description: An old hotel on the north edge of Downtown Vice City with a haunted, foggy interior best visited at night. Enter through the back door and the door locks behind you; fog, flickering lights, self-opening doors and red wall scrawls follow, with a Silent Hill style room.

name: Nitrous Grotti SF90 Garage
description: A fully modified nitrous Grotti supercar (Ferrari SF90 look-alike) sits in the garage of a house on Star Island. Break in at night; you need a cloner key to take the car.

name: Mario and Luigi Hats Easter Egg
description: At the brick ruins by the Water Wheel Meditation at the Lawton Co. Paper Mill, smoke the bong on the table to get high. A floating question block appears above, so climb the ruins and hit it from below to drop two hats marked J and L that dress Jason and Lucia as Mario and Luigi. You must stay high, so smoke again if it wears off.

name: Vice City Portal: Badger R&D Tower Start
description: Climb the Badger R&D Tower in Key Lento, flip the high-voltage switch, turn on the control room TV and press the button. Then press the hidden buttons and levers around the map in order, without fast travelling. A text sends you to the T.H. Power Station between 7 p.m. and 6 a.m., where a reactor portal leads to old Vice City and unlocks Tommy Vercetti's shirt and motorcycle.

name: Mount Kalaga Summit Parachute
description: A free parachute sits on the tallest peak of Mount Kalaga in Mount Kalaga National Park. Land on the summit, grab it, then jump off.

name: Teleporting Barbecue Man
description: A man grilling on the deck of the waterfront house just west of the Badger R&D Tower. Aim a sniper rifle at him from the tower top and he runs from the grill, then teleports to you and kills you in one hit if you look away.

name: Progen Senna at South Ocean Beach
description: A McLaren Senna-style supercar (Progen) is parked in front of a hotel-style entrance between two buildings at the southern end of Ocean Beach, east of the park.

name: Capri Square Arrest Mission
description: As Lucia in the Capri town square, provoke the blonde female cop and the male cop who approach until they arrest you. Letting the arrest happen triggers a hidden mission. It only works with those two cops, not random Capri cops.

name: Southwind Seaplane Dock
description: A seaplane dock on Southwind with a parked floatplane you can take for free in Chapter 1 without police. It is next to the Zero Mile air base, so flying over the base gives a four-star wanted level.

name: Teleporting Green Shirt NPC
description: A pedestrian in a green shirt stands on the street below the Badger R&D Tower in Key Lento. Aim at him from the top of the tower and he dances, then teleports behind you and kills you in one hit if you look away.

name: Status Auto Imports
description: A luxury supercar showroom on the edge of Bayside selling exotics such as the Grotti SF90 type and Progen 720S type. Staff refuse to deal with you if you dress casually, so wear a suit to buy.

name: Key Lento Police Station Weapon Cars
description: Police SUVs parked outside the Key Lento Police Station have weapons in their trunks. Force a trunk open by tapping the right stick to take an assault rifle, a shotgun and body armor for free.

name: Transgressor Wreck 2
description: A second Transgressor wreck sits inside an open garage beside a house at the north end of Port Gellhorn, south of the water tower. Scan it and send the location to Wyman.

name: Trash Island Container Armory
description: A locked SCOOP container behind an orange excavator in the scrap yard on Trash Island, best visited at night. Cut the lock to find a Duke 556 assault rifle, a shotgun, a pistol and boxes of ammo.

name: Chrome Enus Grand Tourer Garage
description: A chrome Enus grand tourer is parked in the garage of a house on Starfish Island. Crouch up to the garage door and break it open to reach the car.

name: Starfish Island Fountain House Garage
description: A garage at the Starfish Island house with the water fountain holds a red Grotti sports car and an orange Pegassi. The Grotti can be broken into or have its key cloned.

name: Pink Pfister Comet Classic Mansion
description: A gated mansion on Casanova Island near Vice Beach. Jump the gate and go up the driveway: a pink classic Pfister Comet is parked by a newer Pfister and a Benefactor off-roader. The classic can be kept or sold for about $17,000.

name: Crazy Cat Lady Apartment
description: The top-floor apartment of the L-shaped apartment building in Little Cuba, full of cats of different breeds and cat photos on the walls. Break down the door on the top floor to get in.

name: Frampton Island Bunker
description: A secret bunker on an empty northern island, reached by boat. The door opens with keypad code 3612. A ladder leads down to rooms with electrical boxes and a creepy room with a man and dialogue.

name: Palmer Fishing Sniper Cache
description: A suppressed FF-SR sniper rifle lies in a pile of crates inside the Palmer Fishing Group compound at the southern tip of Bobcat Key. Go to the right side of the fence, crouch through the broken section and the bushes to avoid the guards, then take it from the boxes.

name: Arthur Morgan Chihuahua Easter Egg
description: A tiny chihuahua with a stuffed Arthur Morgan doll riding it, a Red Dead Redemption 2 nod. It wanders on the wooden boardwalk at Frontier Adventure Golf and runs away when approached.

name: Transgressor Wreck 3
description: The third '67 Transgressor wreck sits on a concrete pad behind the Dirt Merchants mod shop at the south end of Port Gellhorn. Scan all three wrecks for Wyman and pay $1,500, and the restored car waits at his scrapyard.

name: Riata Wreck 1
description: The first of three wrecks for Wyman's '70 Riata, parked under a shed at an abandoned gas station near LTF Airfield. Scan it with your phone.

name: Riata Wreck 2
description: The second Riata wreck, parked under a stilt house off Sunset Drive on the Key Lento waterfront, near the police station. Scan it with your phone.

name: Bullhead Speargun (Drunk Captain)
description: Around 3am a drunk man in a captain's hat wanders near the Crastenburg Hotel carrying a speargun and demands your cash. Refuse once, pay the $5 he haggles down to, then follow him to the hotel pool. While he urinates he drops the Bullhead Speargun and you can pick it up, and also take his hat.

name: Serial Killer Garage House
description: A normal-looking beach house in Key Lento whose garage hides a serial killer's workshop: plastic sheeting, operating table, chainsaw, surgical tools, and a syringe and small container under the table. Break into the garage to see it; breaking into the attached house sets off an alarm. A boat sits outside.

name: Underwater Research Station
description: A small research lab on the seabed in open water east of Little Hardin Island, marked on the surface by a large yellow buoy. Take a boat to the buoy, dive down and swim up through the hatch underneath to get inside. The marker is approximate: look for the buoy.
